name: External Investigation Action Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the requested action, as published in an external investigation action code set.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

IRSI.name: Investigation Request Sent In Error
IRSI.definition: Closure is requested as the investigation request was sent in error.

IRRR.name: Investigation Request Resolved
IRRR.definition: Closure is requested as the investigation request has been resolved by requestor.

IRCD.name: Investigation Response Compensation Disputed
IRCD.definition: Objection is raised as the compensation amount quoted on the investigation response appears incorrect.

IRIC.name: Investigation Response Incomplete
IRIC.definition: Objection is raised as the data provided on the investigation response is insufficent to address the original request.

NARR.name: Narrative
NARR.definition: See AdditionalInformation element for action reason.
